documents.title: 先看这一页：怎么用这份知识库
documents.body:
这不是一本要求你逐字背诵的答案书，而是一个“回答发动机”。每次训练只做三件事：
1. 先直接回答问题。
2. 加一个简单原因或细节。
3. 需要时再给一个小例子，然后停下来。
最低可用目标：Part 1 说 2–4 句；Part 2 能围绕同一件事持续说 1–2 分钟；Part 3 能说“观点 + 原因 + 例子/结果”。句子短一点没关系，最怕的是为了追求高级而停住。

documents.sourceSection: ## 1. 考试地图：你到底要完成什么

documents.title: 1 Part 1：A + W / D（直接回答 + Why / Detail）
documents.body:
课堂笔记写了“AWH”和“PRE”。为了方便使用，我把它整理成更稳的版本：
肯定/中性题：A + W/D
- A — Answer：先给明确答案。
- W — Why：说一个原因。
- D — Detail：补一个时间、地点、人物或小例子。
例：
Q: Do you like your hometown?  
A: Yes, I do. W: It is quiet and people are friendly. D: I usually go to a small park there with my family at weekends.
否定/不喜欢题：P + R + E
- P — Point：先说不喜欢什么。
- R — Reason：说明为什么。
- E — Example：给一个具体场景。
例：
Q: Is there anything you dislike about it?  
P: Yes, the traffic is a problem. R: The roads are often congested during peak hours. E: So it can take me almost an hour to travel a short distance.
长度控制：Part 1 通常 2–4 句就够；考官继续追问时，再多加一层，不要一次说完所有素材。
documents.sourceSection: ### 3.1 Part 1：A + W / D（直接回答 + Why / Detail）

documents.title: 2 Part 2：四格故事法
documents.body:
拿到题卡后的一分钟，不要写完整句子，只写 4–6 个关键词：
1. Who/What：人、物、地点或活动是什么？
2. When/Where：什么时候、在哪里？
3. What happened：发生了什么？按时间顺序说。
4. Why/Feeling：为什么重要？你当时/现在什么感受？
可以用这个口头骨架：
I’d like to talk about…  
I first got to know/see/use it when…  
What happened was…  
The main reason I remember it is that…  
So, even though it was simple, it was important to me.
不要把每个提示点都写成一段范文。每个点说 2–4 句，讲清楚即可；讲完后用一句感受或总结收尾。

documents.title: 3 Part 3：PRE + 对比/结果
documents.body:
Part 3 不要求你讲“正确答案”，而是要你能表达并解释观点。最稳的 4 步是：
1. Point：Personally, I think… / In my view…
2. Reason：The main reason is that…
3. Example：For example, …
4. Result / Contrast：So… / However, … / This may change if…
例：
Q: Why do some people prefer city life?  
In my view, city life is more convenient. The main reason is that people can find more jobs and services there. For example, public transport and hospitals are usually easier to access. However, the cost of living can be much higher.
Part 3 的安全范围：过去 vs 现在、个人 vs 社会、优点 vs 缺点、城市 vs 乡村、原因 → 结果、现在 → 未来。不会抽象词时，先用一个现实例子。

documents.title: 1 你笔记里识别到的连接表达
documents.body:
| 功能 | 好用表达 | 简单例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开始/排序 | first, initially, to start with, in the first place | To start with, it is close to my home. |
| 补充 | and, also, as well, in addition | It is quiet, and it is also quite safe. |
| 转折 | but, while, whereas, although, even though | Although it is small, it is comfortable. |
| 原因 | because, since, as | I like it because it saves time. |
| 结果 | so, therefore, that is why | The roads are busy, so I leave early. |
| 举例 | for example, for instance, including, such as, like | I enjoy outdoor activities, such as walking. |
| 继续/结束 | then, after that, afterwards, later on, finally, at the end | After that, we went home. |
| 对比/总结 | in contrast, to sum up, in short, in conclusion | In short, it is useful but ex
documents.sourceSection: ### 4.1 你笔记里识别到的连接表达

documents.title: 2 卡住时的“安全填充”
documents.body:
这些不是为了拖时间，而是让你有一秒组织语言：
- Well, I’ve never thought about it before, but…
- Let me think for a second.
- I suppose the main reason is…
- What I mean is…
- I don’t know the exact word, but it is a kind of…
- It is hard to explain, but basically…
- For example, in my own experience…
- Sorry, I mean…
不要连续用 “you know / like / actually”。真正有效的补救是换一种简单说法。

documents.title: 1 Study 学习
documents.body:
常见问题：Where are you studying? What do you like about your school? Is your school well-equipped?
- private school 私立学校；public school 公立学校；junior high school 初中；senior high school 高中；university/college 大学
- well-known 有名的；well-equipped 设备齐全的；conveniently located 位置方便的
- international curriculum 国际课程；world-class facilities 世界一流设施（知道即可，不必强行使用）
- urban area 城市地区；suburban area 郊区；rural area/countryside 乡村；remote area 偏远地区
- city centre 市中心；downtown 市中心；in the suburbs 在郊区；on the outskirts 在城市边缘
- hall of residence 学生宿舍；spacious 宽敞的；compact 紧凑但实用的；quiet neighbourhood 安静的街区
- fresh air 新鲜空气；find my inner peace 找到内心平静；release pressure 释放压力；deepen our relationships 加深关系
低基础答案骨架：
I’m studying at a university in [city]. It is in [the city centre / the suburbs], so

documents.title: 2 Hometown 家乡
documents.body:
常见问题：Where are you from? What is the most famous thing in your hometown? Is there anything you dislike about it?
- I was born and raised in… 我在……出生并长大
- I’ve lived there for… 我在那里住了……
- It will always hold a special place in my heart 它永远在我心里占有特殊位置（长句，熟练后再用）
- be famous for 以……出名；citizen 市民；local residents 当地居民
- modern transportation 现代交通；tourist attraction 旅游景点；cultural attraction 人文景观
- picturesque views 如画的风景；embrace nature 亲近自然；unique culture 独特文化
- hospitable 热情好客的；affordable 负担得起的；rich nightlife 丰富的夜生活；landmark 地标
- historic place 历史悠久的地方；ancient architecture 古建筑；young generation 年轻一代
注意：historic 是“有历史意义/历史悠久的”；historical 更偏“与历史有关的”。说不清时用 a place with a long history，更安全。

documents.title: 3 城市的优缺点 City life
documents.body:
优点：
- a fast-paced life 快节奏生活
- a well-developed public transport system 发达的公共交通系统
- more job opportunities 更多工作机会
- a variety of entertainment 多种娱乐活动
- a modern shopping complex 现代购物综合体
- better education resources 更好的教育资源
- well-designed traffic network 设计合理的交通网络
- more facilities, such as hospitals and schools 更多设施，例如医院和学校
缺点：
- congested 拥堵的；polluted 污染的；crowded/overcrowded 拥挤的
- densely populated 人口密集的；annoying 令人烦恼的
- high living costs 高生活成本；high housing prices 高房价
- limited education resources 教育资源有限；fewer job opportunities 更少的工作机会
可直接说的答案：
I prefer living in a city because the public transport is convenient and there are more job opportunities. The downside is that the roads can be congested during peak hours, and housing is expensive. So I e
documents.sourceSection: ### 5.3 城市的优缺点 City life

documents.title: 4 住所 Accommodation
documents.body:
- live in a house / a flat 住在房子/公寓里
- be located in… 位于……；in the heart of the city 在市中心
- in the suburbs 在郊区；a studio apartment 单身公寓；a five-bedroom house 五室住宅
- spacious 宽敞的；compact 紧凑的；quiet neighbourhood 安静的街区
推荐表达：I live in a flat in the suburbs. It is not very big, but it is quiet and convenient. My favourite thing is that I have a small room where I can study and relax.

documents.title: 5 Weather 天气
documents.body:
- climate 气候；mild 温和的；hot and humid 炎热潮湿的；cool 凉爽的
- rainy 多雨的；snowy 多雪的；stormy 暴风雨的
- put on more clothes 多穿衣服；wear sunscreen 涂防晒；get sunburned 被晒伤
回答顺序：总体气候 → 最典型的天气 → 对日常生活的影响。
The weather where I live is usually hot and humid in summer, but it becomes quite mild in autumn. I prefer the cooler months because I can walk outside without feeling tired.

documents.title: 6 Travel 旅行
documents.body:
- travel on a budget 穷游/预算旅行；enrich my experience 丰富经历
- widen my horizons 开阔视野；see breathtaking views 欣赏令人惊叹的风景
- historic remains 历史遗迹；scenic spots 景点；cultural attractions 人文景点
- ancient civilisations 古代文明；meet new people 认识新朋友
- escape from city life 逃离城市生活；recharge myself 恢复精力
- beautiful → picturesque / stunning / breathtaking（选一个会用的即可）
- quiet → peaceful / remote / tranquil（peaceful 最稳）
- wide → vast / endless（wide 本身完全够用）
回答“去过哪些城市”：先分类（国内/国外、大城市/小城市、内陆/沿海），再选一个最难忘的说原因。

documents.title: 7 People 人物与外貌
documents.body:
外貌词：straight / curly / wavy / spiky / short hair；round / oval / square face；wrinkle 皱纹；dimple 酒窝；light/dark skin。
人物品质：
- kind / helpful / caring 善良、乐于助人、体贴
- warm-hearted / hospitable 热心、好客
- hard-working / persistent / diligent / dedicated 勤奋、坚持、投入
- smart / intelligent / talented / gifted 聪明、有天赋
- set a good example 给出好榜样；inspire me a lot 给我很多启发
- admire 欣赏；think highly of 评价很高；look up to 尊敬；respect 尊重；appreciate 感激/欣赏
人物答案骨架：
I’d like to talk about [person]. He/She is [two simple qualities]. For example, [one action]. I admire him/her because [reason], and he/she has set a good example for me.

documents.title: 8 Books, music and feelings 书、音乐与感受
documents.body:
书：comic books 漫画书；novel 小说；e-book 电子书；fairy tale 童话；fiction 小说类文学；science fiction / sci-fi 科幻；spark my curiosity 激发好奇心。
音乐：pop；K-pop；R&B；classical music；hip-hop；rap；jazz；rock。  
唱歌/听感：be out of tune 走调；have a poor sense of rhythm 节奏感差；forget the lyrics 忘记歌词；imitate the singer’s intonation 模仿歌手的语调。
简单感受：happy / excited / cheerful / pleased；feel relaxed；feel stressed / frustrated / disappointed / exhausted。  
“burst with joy / be over the moon”可以理解，但不必把它们作为主力表达。
documents.sourceSection: ### 5.8 Books, music and feelings 书、音乐与感受

documents.title: 9 Food 食物与烹饪
documents.body:
- roast 烤；toast 烘烤面包；bake 烘焙；stew 炖；steam 蒸；boil 煮；barbecue 烧烤
- refreshing 清爽的；mint/minty flavour 薄荷味；sticky rice 糯米
安全句型：It tastes refreshing, and it has a light minty flavour.  不确定具体食材时，用 It is a simple dish made with…，不要硬编复杂配方。

documents.title: 10 Media and technology 媒体与科技
documents.body:
- Bilibili is a social media app and video platform. 它是社交媒体应用和视频平台。
- It is often compared with the Chinese version of YouTube. 可作为解释，但不要把它说成官方定义。
- live stream 直播；live streamer 主播；live commerce 直播电商
- post real-time content 发布实时内容；get likes and comments 获得点赞和评论
- gain followers 获得粉丝；become famous overnight 一夜成名
- watch adventure videos / documentaries / gaming videos / lifestyle videos
- engaging 有吸引力的；meaningful 有意义的；impressive 令人印象深刻的；useful 有用的
- improve / develop / enhance / motivate / stimulate；practical 实用的；multifunctional 多功能的
- brand store 品牌店；duty-free store 免税店；boutique 精品店；e-commerce 电子商务
- influencer 网红/有影响力的人；show off 炫耀；represent one’s success 代表某人的成功
推荐低难度回答：
I often watch short videos on Bilibili. I mainly watch documentaries and gam
documents.sourceSection: ### 5.10 Media and technology 媒体与科技

documents.title: 1 Describe a person you admire
documents.body: I’d like to talk about [a teacher / a friend / a family member]. I met [him/her] when [time]. He/She is kind and hard-working. For example, [specific action]. I admire this person because [reason]. He/She has set a good example for me, so I still think about what I learned from him/her.

documents.title: 2 Describe an experience or trip
documents.body: I’d like to talk about [a trip / an unexpected experience]. It happened [time] in [place]. At first, [background]. Then, something unexpected happened: [event]. I felt [feeling], but I learned [simple lesson]. Looking back, it was memorable because the story did not go as planned.

documents.title: 3 Describe a piece of media or technology
documents.body: The thing I want to talk about is [an app / a video / a livestream]. I first used/watched it [time]. It is useful because [reason 1]. For example, [how you use it]. The only problem is [problem]. Overall, it has become part of my daily life, but I try to use it in a balanced way.
documents.sourceSection: ### 6.3 Describe a piece of media or technology

documents.title: 4 Describe an important object
documents.body:
One important thing I own is [a phone / a piano / a book]. I got it from [person/place] when [time]. I use it for [purpose]. It is important because [personal reason]. It may not be very valuable in money, but it has a special meaning to me.
课堂笔记里的“钢琴”可以这样低难度表达：
I got my piano from my parents on my twelfth birthday. I have had it for about nine years. When I play it, I can forget my problems for a few minutes and relax. That is why it is important to me.

documents.title: 1 必须会的 8 个句型
documents.body:
1. because + 句子：I like it because it is convenient.
2. because of + 名词：The match was cancelled because of the rain.
3. although/even though + 句子：Although it is small, it is comfortable.
4. despite + 名词/动名词：Despite the high cost, I still like living there.
5. 比较级：The city is more convenient, but the countryside is quieter.
6. not as…as…：It is not as expensive as the city centre.
7. when/while/as + 句子：As the day went on, the weather got worse.
8. not until…that…：It was not until she took off her glasses that I realised she was a famous film star.

documents.title: 3 “中文思路 → 英文句子”的修正
documents.body:
- A is made of/from B：A 由 B 制成；A is a kind of B：A 是 B 的一种。
- the main character / the leading character：主角；the plot：情节；the route：路线。
- manage / arrange / divide / allocate time：管理、安排、分配时间；meet my deadlines：按时完成截止任务；avoid procrastination：避免拖延。
- make progress：取得进步；have a good performance：表现良好；improve my language proficiency：提高语言熟练度。
- useful = practical / multifunctional：实用/多功能；engaging：吸引人；dull：枯燥。
documents.sourceSection: ### 7.3 “中文思路 → 英文句子”的修正

documents.title: 4 推荐软件功能卡片
documents.body:
- 今日 25 分钟：自动抽 5 个 Part 1 + 1 个 Part 2 + 1 个 Part 3。
- 同题三档：基础版 / 自然版 / 只改一处版；默认展示基础版。
- 录音复盘：按 F/V/G/P 贴标签，不显示一堆模糊的“综合评分”。
- 词块回收：下一次尽量把用户上次会用的 2 个词块放进新题，不强塞新词。
- 个人事实库：单独存用户自己的学校、家乡、兴趣、人物和经历，生成时优先调用。

documents.title: 3 建议检索和生成规则
documents.body:
给软件的系统提示可以加入：
- 先判断 Part 1/2/3，再选择回答发动机。
- 用户基础较差时，优先生成 2–4 个短句和常用词；不主动塞进罕见同义词、复杂倒装和长难句。
- 不编造用户的城市、学校、家人、旅行经历；缺信息时先给可替换槽位 [city] / [person] / [time]。
- Part 1 默认 20–35 秒；Part 2 默认 90–120 秒；Part 3 默认 4–6 句。根据用户实际语速调整。
- 反馈只指出“一个流利度问题 + 一个最影响准确度的问题 + 一条替换句”。
- 纠错时先给能直接说出口的版本，再给可选升级版；不要把升级版当成必须背诵内容。
- 如果检索到 confidence=medium/low 的手写 OCR，只能说“笔记中可能是……”，不能把它当成标准表达强推。

documents.title: 最后检查表：今天能不能开口
documents.body:
- [ ] 我能在 3 秒内开始回答，而不是先想完整中文。
- [ ] 我能用 because / but / for example 说出三句相连的话。
- [ ] 我不知道一个词时，会解释它，而不是停住。
- [ ] 我的一段回答里至少有一个具体时间、地点、人物或例子。
- [ ] 我录音回听时，整体意思能听懂。
- [ ] 我今天只改了 1–2 个问题，并且第二遍真的更顺。
documents.sourceSection: ## 12. 最后检查表：今天能不能开口

documents.title: 2 四项评分的“够用版”
documents.body:
| 评分项 | 你要练的最小动作 | 不要陷入的误区 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fluency & Coherence 流利与连贯 | 说短句，允许自然停顿；用少量连接词把思路串起来 | 连接词堆满；每句都说 “you know” |
| Lexical Resource 词汇 | 熟词说准；不会时会解释；积累主题词块 | 只追求生僻词、成语和“看起来像范文”的表达 |
| Grammar 语法 | 主谓一致、时态、可数名词、比较句先稳定 | 为了复杂而复杂；一个长句错到底 |
| Pronunciation 发音 | 重音、分组、句尾清楚；整体可理解 | 试图消灭口音；只盯单个音，不练整句 |

documents.title: 1 一句话三层练法
documents.body:
拿一句你自己的答案，例如：I prefer living in the suburbs because it is quieter.
1. 慢速清楚：每个词说完整。
2. 分组：I prefer living in the suburbs / because it is quieter.
3. 重音：突出 prefer, suburbs, quieter，弱化小词。
课堂笔记提到 imitate tones / intonation / pronunciation / accent；把它落地为“跟读整句 + 录音对比”，不要只模仿单个单词。
